summary: Comprehensive testing of NavCom Connect -> SC Group Finder rebrand. All major UI rebranding changes verified working: Header logo (SC GROUP FINDER + PLAYER CONTRACT BOARD subtitle), nav (JOB BOARD/SIGNALS/LOUNGE(LFG)/OTHER TOOLS dropdown with Intel+Roadmap), Directory removed from desktop and mobile nav, Region prompt modal with data-testids (region-prompt-modal/region-select/region-set-btn/region-skip-btn) accepting USA/Europe/Australia/Asia, header region display (REGION/USA), Contracts page rename (// GROUP_FINDER, Job Board, MY REGION:, POST JOB / GROUP, POST_JOB modal, POST TYPE label, no CONTRACT CATEGORY), Settings (Current Server Region, About SC Group Finder, current-region-value/change-region-btn/set-region-btn data-testids), Onboarding Carousel (Welcome to SC Group Finder, final slide 'Set Your Server Region' with onboarding-region-select), AlertTicker (uses uppercase region or YOUR REGION label, no 'Shard NNN'), Login subtitle and About SC Group Finder link. Backend: contracts endpoint accepts shard='USA'/'Europe' region strings; signals/report accepts shard region strings; alerts return region values. No user-visible 'shard' text in any rebranded page (verified with innerText to exclude inline <style> CSS class names).

critical_code_review_comments: Code retains internal 'shard' identifier names (CSS class names like .shard-display, .shard-setting, .shard-number; localStorage key 'navcom_token'/'navcom_onboarding_done'/'navcom_tickers'; component className 'navcom-page'/'navcom-header'/'navcom-logo'/'navcom-nav'/'navcom-avatar') - these are NOT user-visible but indicate the rebrand is text/UI-level only as expected per the brief.
userShard is intentionally session-scoped (App.js line 76: 'Session-based, not localStorage'). This means the region prompt modal appears every login as documented. Confirmed working as intended.
Backend retains `shard` field in ContractCreate, ReportCreate, alerts response per the brief — region strings (USA/Europe/Australia/Asia/Global) are stored unchanged, filter logic identical.
Onboarding Carousel persists 'navcom_onboarding_done' to localStorage so it only shows once per device — region prompt continues to show every session via App-level state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (26/26 rebrand UI tests passed after correct test setup)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_REBRAND_USA Job contract (id deleted attempt returned 405; contract still exists in DB). Created TEST signal report with shard=Europe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand complete and verified. Key gotchas for future agents: (1) Onboarding Carousel pops up first; set localStorage.setItem('navcom_onboarding_done','true') and reload to skip directly to region prompt modal. (2) userShard is session state only — page.goto() does a full page reload which RESETS userShard; use SPA navigation (clicking links) or re-set region after navigation. (3) Settings page 'About' content is in About tab — must click About in sidebar. (4) Use page.evaluate('() => element.innerText') instead of textContent to avoid matching CSS class names in inline <style> blocks (e.g., .shard-setting CSS class is in <style> textContent but not innerText). (5) Backend signals endpoint is /api/signals/report (singular) and requires field 'type' (not 'category'). (6) DELETE /api/contracts/{id} returns 405 - use a different cleanup mechanism if needed.
